function.name: nmap
function.description: Run an Nmap network scan against an authorized lab/engagement target. Supports host discovery, port/service/version scan, OS detect, and NSE scripts.

target.description: Target host, CIDR, or hostname (authorized scope only).

ports.description: Port list/range for -p (e.g. '22,80,443' or '1-1024'). null = Nmap default.

scan_type.description: Primary scan flag without leading dash (sS SYN, sT connect, sU UDP, sV version, sn ping, A aggressive).

scripts.description: NSE script or category for --script (e.g. 'vuln', 'http-enum'). null = none.

timing.description: T0-T5 timing template as integer 0-5. null = default T3.

extra_args.description: Additional safe allow-listed args (e.g. '-Pn -n'). null = none.
